summary: The tags keyword adds tags to tasks, includes, blocks, plays, roles or imports; it never selects tasks, which is only done on the command line.
questions: Does the tags keyword choose which tasks run?
Where can I put tags in a playbook?

answer_card.title: The tags keyword
answer_card.answer_md: `tags` can go on a task, include, block, play, role or import. It only **adds** tags; selecting or skipping tasks happens on the **command line**.
